sloka: ज्योतिष्टोम आयुषी च एवम् अतिरात्रौ विनिर्मितौ ।अभिजित् विश्वजित् च एवम् अप्तोर्यामो महाक्रतुः ॥१-१४-४२॥
transliteration: jyotiṣṭoma āyuṣī ca evam atirātrau vinirmitau ।abhijit viśvajit ca evam aptoryāmo mahākratuḥ ॥1-14-42॥

translations.english: In order to promote his dynasty, king Dasaratha gave away eastern region to Hotar, western region to Adhvaryu, southern region to Brahma and northern region to Udgata. These offerings were made in accordance with theprescriptions by Brahma long all.
